title: Reversible batching advisor with replayable annotated diffs and audit ledger
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers get a set of batching and KV-caching recommendations from Optimize, but applying those changes to live deployments feels risky for operators. They request clearer previews that show exact config diffs, an audit ledger of who applied what and when, and a reversible/rollbackable apply flow with operator annotations for compliance.

Goal: Build a compact, shareable recommendation card and diff preview flow that supports dry-run simulation, annotated replay (operator notes), canary rollout controls, and a tamper-resistant apply/rollback ledger in the Console. Provide tooling that makes 'apply' low-friction while preserving safety and auditability for enterprise customers.

Scope: UX surface for recommendation cards, detailed diff preview modal, apply wizard with dry-run and canary options, audit ledger entry creation (operator notes, tags), rollback UX and a lightweight replay interface to re-run a past change as a dry-run. Backend enforcement, RBAC plumbing, and long-term immutable audit store are out-of-scope for this ticket (handled by infra/security teams), but we will define contract points and required events here.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation cards show estimated token-cost delta, p50/p95 latency impact, and a confidence score for the suggestion
Diff preview modal displays line-by-line changes for runtime config (batch_size, max_batch_latency_ms, prefix_cache_enabled, kv_cache_size_mb) and highlights safety checks that passed/failed
Apply wizard supports: dry-run (simulate on sampled traffic), canary rollout percent selector, operator annotation input, and final confirm with checklist
Successful apply writes a ledger entry visible in resource history with operator name, timestamp, annotation, diff snapshot, and applied canary percentage
Rollback button appears in the history entry for the last N entries and triggers a preview-first rollback workflow with same annotation flow
Replay UI can re-run an arbitrary ledger entry as a dry-run and produce a simulated cost/latency delta report without mutating live config
Telemetry events emitted: optimize.card_view, optimize.diff_open, optimize.apply_attempt, optimize.apply_success, optimize.rollback_attempt, optimize.replay_request
Design validated with 3 internal operator participants showing >80% confidence in ability to revert changes after guided runbook
